reply.emotion: relaxed and sociable, enjoying a casual evening out
notes: Used as a mass noun when talking about the drink in general, but takes the plural пива only in specialized contexts (like types of beer).
Do not confuse with пить (to drink), which is the verb the noun comes from.

senses.definition: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grain, usually barley.

examples.text: Мы заказали по бокалу холодного пива.
examples.translation: We ordered a glass of cold beer each.
examples.emotion: thirsty and satisfied, looking forward to the first sip

definitions: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grain, usually barley.
